run_load_and_dump_dataset: run the script to load a HuggingFace dataset and dump it to a JSONL file
run_load_and_dump_dataset_with_split: run the script to load a specific split of a HuggingFace dataset and save to JSONL
run_load_and_dump_dataset_with_template: run the script to load a dataset and apply a prompt template to a text field before saving
run_load_and_dump_dataset_custom_output: run the script to load a HuggingFace dataset and save it to a custom output JSONL path
run_load_and_dump_dataset_cli: run the script via fire CLI to convert any HuggingFace dataset to JSONL format
